content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am facing an issue where my laptop was stolen and now I've replaced it. My original [product_name] [version_no] software will not load when I try to install it on the new laptop. Is it necessary to purchase another license for [product_name] software in this situation?

It sounds like the [version_no] software you have may only be an upgrade rather than a full version. To install an upgrade, you must have a full version already installed on your laptop or possess the original installation CD or DVD, even if it's an older version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users replacing their hardware are reporting issues reinstalling and loading [product_name] [version_no] software, mainly around licensing and upgrade requirements. This leads to confusion when the software does not install successfully on new equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to reinstall and continue using their existing [product_name] [version_no] software without having to make an additional purchase after replacing their hardware.
